comparison.objective: Fit and hand-tighten an oxygen regulator onto a keyed cylinder valve; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Record requires yoke placement, multi-pin alignment, washer seating and T-screw tightening. Candidate requires hex-key unlocking, collar adjustment, relocking and iterative dynamic trials.
comparison.success_condition: Record checks pin depth, washer gap, angular alignment, screw seating and safe release. Candidate checks repeated stopping performance; rebound, overload and drift limits are missing.
comparison.reason: Although both include alignment and tightening, regulator installation tests multi-feature insertion and sealing rather than calibration of dynamic response.
